2.w: “How long will you torment me and crush me with your words?

3.w: These ten times you have been reproaching me; you are not ashamed to attack me.

4.w: But even if it were true that I have erred, my error remains solely my concern!

5.w: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and plead my disgrace against me,

6.w: know then that God has wronged me and encircled me with his net.

7.w: “If I cry out, ‘Violence!’ I receive no answer; I cry for help, but there is no justice.

8.w: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass and has set darkness over my paths.

9.w: He has stripped me of my honor and has taken the crown off my head.

10.w: He tears me down on every side until I perish; he uproots my hope like an uprooted tree.

11.w: Thus his anger burns against me, and he considers me among his enemies.

12.w: His troops advance together; they throw up a siege ramp against me, and they camp around my tent.

13.w: “He has put my relatives far from me; my acquaintances only turn away from me.

14.w: My kinsmen have failed me; my friends have forgotten me.

15.w: My guests and my servant girls consider me a stranger; I am a foreigner in their eyes.

16.w: I summon my servant, but he does not respond, even though I implore him with my own mouth.

17.w: My breath is repulsive to my wife; I am loathsome to my brothers.

18.w: Even youngsters have scorned me; when I get up, they scoff at me.

19.w: All my closest friends detest me; and those whom I love have turned against me.

20.w: My bones stick to my skin and my flesh; I have escaped alive with only the skin of my teeth.

21.w: Have pity on me, my friends, have pity on me, for the hand of God has struck me.

22.w: Why do you pursue me like God does? Will you never be satiated with my flesh?

23.w: “O that my words were written down! O that they were written on a scroll!

24.w: O that with an iron chisel and with lead they were engraved in a rock forever!

25.w: As for me, I know that my Redeemer lives, and that as the last he will stand upon the earth.

26.w: And after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God,

27.w: whom I will see for myself, and whom my own eyes will behold, and not another. My heart grows faint within me.

28.w: If you say, ‘How we will pursue him, since the root of the trouble is found in him!’

29.w: Fear the sword yourselves, for wrath brings the punishment by the sword, so that you may know that there is judgment.”
